steps.title: Analyze User Crash Report
steps.description: Inspect MainActivity.java to identify the source of the application crash upon startup.

steps.title: Locate Deliberate Error
steps.description: Find the deliberate java.lang.Error thrown during the onCreate method of MainActivity.

steps.title: Remove Crashing Code Block
steps.description: Delete the conditional statement throwing the system error in MainActivity.java to ensure smooth application execution.

steps.title: Verify Handler Thread Safety
steps.description: Check handler and runnable reference updates in the MainActivity life cycle to avoid memory leaks.

steps.title: Validate Android Manifest Configuration
steps.description: Confirm manifest settings package name 'com.timeonly.app' is configured properly with appropriate default themes.

steps.title: Review Build Gradle Settings
steps.description: Ensure build configuration matches target compileSdk 34 and uses correct Java 8 compilation standards.

steps.title: Verify Theme Style References
steps.description: Confirm style references in AndroidManifest.xml utilize standard platform light themes correctly.

steps.title: Confirm User Layout Elements
steps.description: Validate relative layout structure in activity_main.xml displays text view correctly centered with monospaced style.

steps.title: Verify Metadata Integrity
steps.description: Ensure app-meta.json maintains accurate application name and package identifiers.

steps.title: Building Time Only
steps.description: Compile and assemble the corrected project debug APK using the Gradle 8.5 command.
